name: luxin
description: Generate images, video, audio, and 3D models without an API key or a billing account. The agent signs itself up in one command, starts on free preview credits, and runs text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, text-to-audio, and image-to-3D (one photo to a textured glb mesh) through one hosted CLI. Every result returns a hosted media URL with no signature or expiry, a job id the agent can re-fetch, and a receipt for what the call cost. When the credits run out, the agent hands its human one dashboard link to fund more. Use when a task asks to generate or edit an image, make a short video, produce music or sound effects, or turn an image into a 3D asset, and no provider API key, account, or billing setup is available.
